title: The First Real Defeat
summary: Deep in the water reservoir, Ha-Jun undergoes grueling blindfolded sensory conditioning. He masters Sovereign Blood Weaving, learning to read vibrations in the air and fluids before kinetic strikes land.

panels.shot: blindfolded ha-jun standing in water wide shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands motionless in knee-deep water, a black cloth blindfold tied across his eyes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands motionless in knee-deep water, a black cloth blindfold tied across his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ghutnon tak pani mein nishchal khada hai, uski aankhon par kale kapde ki patti bandhi hui hai.

panels.shot: ten obsidian feather daggers floating around kuro
panels.action: Ten razor-sharp obsidian feathers hover in midair, vibrating with high-frequency purple mana.
panels.prose_en: Ten razor-sharp obsidian feathers hover in midair, vibrating with high-frequency purple mana.
panels.prose_hi: Das ustra-nukile obsidian pankh uchch aavritti wale baingani man ke saath kampan karte hue, madhya hawa mein mandrate han.

panels.shot: kuro firing first dagger at supersonic speed
panels.action: The first feather launches forward like a bullet straight toward Ha-Jun's blindfolded throat.
panels.prose_en: The first feather launches forward like a bullet straight toward Ha-Jun's blindfolded throat.
panels.prose_hi: Pahla pankh goli ki tarah sidhe ha-jun ki aankhon par patti bandhe gale ki or badhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun tilting head 2 inches to the right
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his chin two inches to the right; the feather slices through a single strand of hair.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tilts his chin two inches to the right; the feather slices through a single strand of hair.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni thuddi ko dahini or do inch jhukata hai; pankh baalon ki ek hi lat ko kaatata hai.

panels.shot: feather embedding into concrete column behind
panels.action: The feather embeds four inches into solid reinforced concrete, vibrating with leftover kinetic energy.
panels.prose_en: The feather embeds four inches into solid reinforced concrete, vibrating with leftover kinetic energy.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh char inch thos prabalit concrete mein sama jata hai, jo bachi hui gatij urja se kampan karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro firing three daggers simultaneously from angles
panels.action: Three daggers launch from triangle vectors: left flank, right kidney, and overhead.
panels.prose_en: Three daggers launch from triangle vectors: left flank, right kidney, and overhead.
panels.prose_hi: Teen khanjar trikon vactor se launch hote han: bayan parshv, dayan gurda aur upari bhag.

panels.shot: ha-jun sensing ripples in the water beneath boots
panels.action: Ha-Jun's boots detect minute pressure ripples travelling through the water surface.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hawa ka दबाव... Paani ka vibration... Sabkuch ek clear picture bana raha hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's boots detect minute pressure ripples travelling through the water surface.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke jute pani ki satah se guzarne wali sookshm dabav tarangon ka pata lagate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun ducking and spinning cleanly
panels.action: Ha-Jun ducks beneath the overhead dagger while spinning his torso; the two flank daggers miss by millimeters.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun ducks beneath the overhead dagger while spinning his torso; the two flank daggers miss by millimeters.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne dhad ko ghumate hue upari khanjar ke neeche jhuk jata hai; donon parshva khanjar millimeter se chuk gaye.

panels.shot: kuro grinning with pride in air
panels.action: Kuro cackles: 'Not bad! Lekin Captain Baek projectile nahi, pure heavy steel chala raha tha!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Heavy impact ko sirf dodge nahi, absorb aur redirect karna hoga!

panels.prose_en: Kuro cackles: 'Not bad! Lekin Captain Baek projectile nahi, pure heavy steel chala raha tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chillata hai: 'bura nahin! lekin captain bak projectile nahin, shuddh bhari steel chala raha tha!'.

panels.shot: kuro swooping down with giant phantom claw
panels.action: Kuro channels ancient sovereign mana, projecting a 10-foot shadowy demonic claw descending like a hammer.
panels.prose_en: Kuro channels ancient sovereign mana, projecting a 10-foot shadowy demonic claw descending like a hammer.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro prachin samprabhu man ko prasarit karta hai, jisme hathaude ki tarah utarta hua 10 foot ka chhayadar rakshasi panja dikhai deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising right arm with blood weaving
panels.action: Ha-Jun summons liquid blood from his ring, weaving it into spiraling tensile bands around his forearm.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun summons liquid blood from his ring, weaving it into spiraling tensile bands around his forearm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni anguthi se taral rakt ko bulata hai, aur use apni baanh ke charon or sarpil tanya band mein bunata hai.

panels.shot: phantom claw striking blood spirals
panels.action: The massive phantom claw slams into the woven blood bands; the blood compresses like a hydraulic spring.
panels.prose_en: The massive phantom claw slams into the woven blood bands; the blood compresses like a hydraulic spring.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal pret panja bune hue rakt bandon se takrata hai; rakt hydraulic spring ki tarah sankuchit hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun redirecting kinetic force into water
panels.action: Ha-Jun redirects the entire 5-ton kinetic impact into the water around his feet, blasting a 20-foot geyser.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine impact absorb nahi kiya... Maine use ground mein channel kar diya!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun redirects the entire 5-ton kinetic impact into the water around his feet, blasting a 20-foot geyser.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun poore 5-tan gatij prabhav ko apne pairon ke aaspaas ke pani mein punarnirdeshit karta hai, jisse 20-fut geyser nasht ho jata hai.

panels.shot: water splashing down like rain in cavern
panels.action: Gallons of displaced water rain down back into the reservoir as Ha-Jun remains standing upright.
panels.prose_en: Gallons of displaced water rain down back into the reservoir as Ha-Jun remains standing upright.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke sidhe khade rahane par gallon visthapit pani wapas jalashay mein gir jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun untying black blindfold
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the soaked blindfold from his eyes; his dual-ringed irises shine with peerless clarity.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ab main dekh sakta hoon... Dushman ki muscle twitch hone se pehle uska path.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pulls the soaked blindfold from his eyes; his dual-ringed irises shine with peerless clarity.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni aankhon se bheegi hui patti khinchta hai; uski dohri anguthi wali putli advitiya spashtata ke saath chamakti hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder bowing head
panels.action: Kuro bows with genuine solemn respect: 'Blood Weaving Mastery: Rank C. Tumne ek din mein woh seekha jo saalon lagte hain.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein First Sovereign ke blood ho, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Kuro bows with genuine solemn respect: 'Blood Weaving Mastery: Rank C. Tumne ek din mein woh seekha jo saalon lagte hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro vastavik samman ke saath jhukta hai: 'rakt bunai mein maharat: rank si. tumne ek din mein woh seekha jo saalon lagte han.'

panels.shot: bone gauntlet splint dissolving into light
panels.action: The wooden splints around his left arm fall away; the broken bone has fully fused, denser than titanium.

dialogue.text:
[SKELETAL REGENERATION 100% COMPLETE]
Bone Density Multiplier: +550%
New Trait: Kinetic Dispersal Marrow.

panels.prose_en: The wooden splints around his left arm fall away; the broken bone has fully fused, denser than titanium.
panels.prose_hi: Uski bayin bhuja ke charon or lagi lakdi ki khpacchiyan door gir jaati han; tuti hui haddi puri tarah se jud gai hai, jo titanium se bhi adhik saghan hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun flexing left fingers without pain
panels.action: Ha-Jun makes a crushing fist with his left bone gauntlet; zero pain, pure reinforced power.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun makes a crushing fist with his left bone gauntlet; zero pain, pure reinforced power.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni bayin haddi ke hathiyar se kuchalne wali mutthi banata hai; shunya dard, shuddh prabalit shakti.

panels.shot: min-jae running across platform waving tablet
panels.action: Min-Jae runs to the edge: 'Ha-Jun! Bureau ke encrypted radio par emergency broadcast shuru ho gayi hai!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Director Kang ne Mapo Bridge par human hostage trap lagaya hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs to the edge: 'Ha-Jun! Bureau ke encrypted radio par emergency broadcast shuru ho gayi hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je kinare ki or daudta hai: 'ha-jun! bureau ke encrypted radio par aapatkalin prasaran shuru ho gaya hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping out of water onto platform
panels.action: Ha-Jun hoists himself out of the water, water draining from his dark tactical combat pants.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hoists himself out of the water, water draining from his dark tactical combat pants.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun khud ko pani se bahar nikalta hai, uske gahre samrik ladaku pant se pani bahane lagta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae showing drone livestream
panels.action: Drone camera shows Mapo Bridge: twenty school buses trapped behind barricades in heavy night rain.
panels.prose_en: Drone camera shows Mapo Bridge: twenty school buses trapped behind barricades in heavy night rain.
panels.prose_hi: Dron camera mepo bridge dikhata hai: raat ki bhari baarish mein bees school basen barricades ke peeche fans gain.

panels.shot: director kang speaking on public loudspeaker
panels.action: Director Kang stands on an armored carrier with a megaphone: 'Ha-Jun Kang! Surrender within 30 minutes or these buses burn!'

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: Ek Demon ke liye 500 bacchon ki jaan... Tum chunoge kya, Sovereign Heir?!

panels.prose_en: Director Kang stands on an armored carrier with a megaphone: 'Ha-Jun Kang! Surrender within 30 minutes or these buses burn!'.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang ek bakhtarband vahak par megaphone ke saath khade han: 'ha-jun cong! 30 minute ke andar surrender karo varna yeh basen jal jaengi!'

panels.shot: captain baek standing beside kang with folded arms
panels.action: Captain Baek stands beside him, his jaw clenched tight in visible moral conflict.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek stands beside him, his jaw clenched tight in visible moral conflict.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak uske bagal mein khada hai, drishyaman naitik sangharsh mein uska jabda kaskar bhincha hua hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun jaw hardening with icy resolve
panels.action: Ha-Jun zips up his dark windbreaker, pulling on black fingerless tactical gloves.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Innocent bacchon ko dhaal banaya... Director Kang insaan kehlane ke laayak nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun zips up his dark windbreaker, pulling on black fingerless tactical gloves.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apne gahre rang ke vindbraker ki zip band kar di aur kale ungli rahit samrik dastaane pahan liye.

panels.shot: min-jae loading decryption files onto usb drive
panels.action: Min-Jae inserts a titanium USB drive into his pocket: 'Maine Tae-Jun ke journal aur Chimera files ki copy bana li hai.'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Agar yeh information media aur Captain Baek ko mil jaye, toh Bureau toot jayega!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae inserts a titanium USB drive into his pocket: 'Maine Tae-Jun ke journal aur Chimera files ki copy bana li hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apni jeb mein ek titanium usb drive dalta hai: 'maine taaye-jun ke journal aur chimera filon ki copy bana lee hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun placing hand on min-jae shoulder
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at Min-Jae with deep brotherly trust: 'Tum bridge ke broadcast van ko target karna.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Screen par sachayi chalao. Main Baek aur Kang ko sambhalunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at Min-Jae with deep brotherly trust: 'Tum bridge ke broadcast van ko target karna.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun gahre bhaichare wale vishwas ke saath min-je ko dekhta hai: 'tum bridge ke broadcast van ko target karna.'

panels.shot: kuro expanding wings to six-foot span
panels.action: Kuro's obsidian wings expand, glowing with radiant violet energy: 'Time to hunt the hunters.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Chalo, Ha-Jun! Sovereign ki pehli real battle shuru karte hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's obsidian wings expand, glowing with radiant violet energy: 'Time to hunt the hunters.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ke obsidian pankh ujjwal baingani urja se chamakte hue failte han: 'shikariyon ka shikar karne ka samay.'

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping up maintenance access ladder
panels.action: Ha-Jun bounds up the 80-foot vertical iron ladder in three explosive jumps.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bounds up the 80-foot vertical iron ladder in three explosive jumps.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun teen visfotak chlangon mein 80 foot ki khadi lohe ki sidhi par chadh jata hai.

panels.shot: kicking open manhole cover onto rain-slicked street
panels.action: Ha-Jun kicks the heavy cast-iron manhole cover into the air, leaping onto the street.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun kicks the heavy cast-iron manhole cover into the air, leaping onto the street.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bhari kacche lohe ke manhol cover ko hawa mein uchhalta hai aur sadak par uchhal jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing on empty wet asphalt facing bridge
panels.action: Lightning flashes over the Han River; Mapo Bridge blazes with police beacons 500 meters ahead.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aaj raat... main aur nahi chupunga.

panels.prose_en: Lightning flashes over the Han River; Mapo Bridge blazes with police beacons 500 meters ahead.
panels.prose_hi: Han nadi par bijli chamakti hai; mepo bridge 500 meter aage police ki lalbiyon se jagmaga raha hai.
